== Summary ==
Slip “•Endor: Rebel Landing Site (Forest)” cut unchanged from page 10 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF file created 10 August 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (69, 75, 581, 798)). Version [[Endor: Rebel Landing Site (Forest) (V)]] (Original). Not a recreation.
